reviews.title: Amazing headset!
reviews.comment: I love these headphones! They have introduced me to a whole new world of video game immersion. I honestly cant imagine gaming without this level of audio quality from this point on. I cant say if they are better than other other headsets competing at this level. I can say that I myself am very happy with this purchase.
reviews.author: Sunshine

reviews.title: My favorite headphones ever. Perfect for my big ears and comfy for long sessions
reviews.comment: These are by far my favorite headphones.  I've had top of the line rig and steelseries.  In fact my plan was to return these when I got the rig 900 (because they work natively on Xbox, PC , and ps and that's really what I'm looking for is one headset for everything) but I like these so much that I'm keeping these and the rig.  I love the OLED controller, it looks cool but it's also useful. I have it attached to my PC and use it to keep track of GPU and CPU temps. I bought these refurbished in excellent condition and they look like brand new.  They came in a bag instead of a box otherwise I would have had no idea they weren't new.  Definitely worth the discount. These are heavy in the hands and have a premium feel. I thought they would be heavy on the head but they're not. They are perfect for long gaming sessions and the ear cups go around my big ears without issue. It's cool to have haptics but I'm not really using them. Maybe I'll use them more as I use these more. 5 of 5 would recommend to anyone (especially refurb or at a discounted price) Oh and I'm not sure if they work on Xbox yet. They do not natively but I think you could hook them up to a controller through provided 3.5mm Jack and use them that way. I haven't tried yet. Will update when I do.
